name: Opening a decorated declaration reapplies decorators in source order

input.source_text: @one() @two() class A { }; let before = A.decorators; A.open() { |t| t.define_method(:x) { 1 } }; [before, A.decorators]

applicability.reason: Observes decorator replay for an open candidate; upgrade, rollback and generic materialization need their subsystems.
